currentnessFindings.finding: The September 2026 application correctly presents up to 12 for a NEW group home under current Ministry intake policy. Existing group homes may apply for up to 16 only after holding a REGULAR licence for at least two years and meeting need, space and other approval requirements. The statutory ceiling of 16 is not an initial licence entitlement.

Use the September 2026 application. It asks entitlement to work AND study, adds the Act/regulations acknowledgment, and uses an existing-care checkbox. The former Saskatoon Open Door Society question has been removed.
Use M221 Rev.12/23, with supplier fields and Ministry phone-verification section. An electronic signature needs digital certification or an identifying audit trail. Do not use older indexed forms.

Current catalogues publish December 2025 Active Play and Play & Exploration forms and planning templates. The webpage statement that forms are only supplied after application is not an availability restriction. Grant eligibility and timing still apply.

The current published self-assessment still prints a 40-hour ECE course. Current regulation 61 requires a 45-hour introductory course or approved equivalent within one year; group ECE I within three years. Do not validate using the stale printed 40-hour number.

The current FAQ lists $3,325 for start-up, but the current grant form and grant webpage list $3,525 for a family home. Use the actual grant form for the requested amount and flag the discrepancy for confirmation.

The historical checklist is visible in the search index, but its live URL returns 404 and it is absent from the current opening-home catalogue. Use the current application page/FAQ for process: two initial sessions, two final sessions, Learning Plans, visits and local-need screening. No guaranteed four-week issuance.
An assistant must be present whenever numbers AND ages exceed the family-home chart, including some combinations of eight or fewer. Working alone requires compliance with family-home limits.

Consent to optional third-party contact releases, parental referral opt-out, and disclosure of relevant criminal-check information are three distinct matters. Do not merge them into one consent checkbox.

Fire/Health/Safety is usually paid after fire inspection before opening; Start-Up is paid after licence issuance. Active Play requires a licensed home; Play & Exploration requires the home provider’s Phase I workshop certificate. Optional grant forms never block the initial licence packet.

routeBranches.condition: Not already licensed for this home; residential child care with up to eight attending children, subject to age and resident-child rules.

routeBranches.label: New group family child care home
routeBranches.condition: Not already licensed for this home; initial group licence may have up to 12 spaces. Assistant required whenever family-home number/age limits are exceeded.
routeBranches.futureCondition: Existing group home: at least two years with a regular licence; expansion approval and all other requirements.

routeBranches.label: Convert an existing licensed family home to a group home
routeBranches.condition: Existing licensed family home seeking conversion.

routeBranches.label: Expand an existing group home beyond 12 spaces
routeBranches.condition: Existing licensed group home with at least two years on a regular licence; demonstrated need in a Ministry-identified area and adequate space/staffing.

routeBranches.label: Update an existing home licence
routeBranches.condition: Change name, address, residents, licence type or spaces. Add expansion questionnaire only for conversion to group or expansion beyond 12.

mandatoryVsOptionalPolicy.explicit: Use requirements directly stated in a current form, regulation or process instruction.
mandatoryVsOptionalPolicy.conditional: Evaluate selected route, grant choice, existing/new status and factual applicability first.
mandatoryVsOptionalPolicy.unmarked: A printed blank line alone does not establish mandatory validation. Highlight missing relevant information for review without invented hard stops.
mandatoryVsOptionalPolicy.thirdParty: Never block applicant readiness because a consultant, reference, bank or inspector has not completed a section that belongs to them. Separately track external evidence needed for final licensing.
mandatoryVsOptionalPolicy.optionalGrant: Declining or not selecting a grant does not make the licensing application incomplete.
